summary: Beta.3 reduces repeated electrical preparation and result allocations while preserving API 1.0.0, saved worlds and all 16 substeps. The large-yard 20 TPS goal remains open.
changes: Reuses built-in terminal identities and validated CEE descriptions, and reduces result-map and availability-mask allocations.
Includes the disconnected-wire and repeated-diagnostics corrections since beta.2.
Adds the original mixed benchmark save, correctly labeled 14,650 electrical nodes, 20,637 connections and 1,050 stateful devices.
installation: Use Minecraft 1.21.1, NeoForge 21.1.231 or 21.1.248, Java 21, Create 6.0.10-280, CEE 1.1.3, Power Grid 0.6.2 and Architectury 13.0.8. Match server and client mod versions.
optional_installation: Pinout editions also require CC:Tweaked 1.120.2 and CC;CPG: Pinout 0.2.1.
